title: Robust Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis via Iterative Proxy Correction
abstract: arXiv:2608.19971v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to infer affective states by integrating language, visual, and acoustic cues. However, real-world multimodal inputs are often incomplete or corrupted, which can weaken cross-modal complementarity and introduce misleading information into downstream fusion. Existing proxy-based methods for incomplete MSA commonly rely on one-shot proxy construction to compensate for degraded language information, but the generated proxy may be coarse or unreliable at initialization. Prematurely injecting such a proxy into multimodal reasoning can propagate initial errors and compromise sentiment prediction. To address this limitation, we propose an iterative proxy correction framework for robust incomplete MSA. Our method constructs a language-oriented proxy from non-language modalities and progressively refines it under multimodal context through gated residual correction. translated_title: 基于迭代代理校正的鲁棒不完整多模态情感分析
translated_abstract: 多模态情感分析旨在通过整合语言、视觉和听觉线索来推断情感状态。然而，现实世界中的多模态输入往往不完整或受损，这可能会削弱跨模态互补性，并将误导性信息引入下游融合。现有基于代理的不完整MSA方法通常依赖一次性代理构建来补偿退化的语言信息，但生成的代理在初始化时可能粗糙或不可靠。过早地将这种代理注入多模态推理会传播初始错误并损害情感预测。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种用于鲁棒不完整MSA的迭代代理校正框架。我们的方法从非语言模态构建语言导向代理，并通过门控残差校正，在多模态上下文下逐步细化它。校正后的代理随后被自适应融合。
tldr: 本文提出一种迭代代理校正框架，通过从非语言模态构建并逐步细化语言导向代理，避免一次性代理的初始误差，从而提升不完整多模态情感分析的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an iterative proxy correction framework that constructs and progressively refines a language-oriented proxy from non-language modalities, avoiding initial errors of one-shot proxies to enhance robustness in incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis.
